name: Theranos

summary.text: Theranos was a Palo Alto blood-testing company founded by Elizabeth Holmes. Its board, as listed by Fortune in 2015, included former secretaries of state Henry Kissinger and George Shultz, former senators Sam Nunn and Bill Frist, former defense secretary William Perry, retired generals James Mattis and Gary Roughead, and others. In March 2018 the SEC charged Theranos, Holmes and former president Ramesh 'Sunny' Balwani with raising more than $700 million from investors while deceiving them about the company's technology and business; Theranos and Holmes settled. In January 2022 a federal jury convicted Holmes on four counts of defrauding investors, and in July 2022 a jury convicted Balwani on all twelve counts against him.

facts.claim: On March 14, 2018 the SEC charged Theranos, Holmes and Balwani with violating Section 17(a) of the Securities Act and Section 10(b) of the Exchange Act and Rule 10b-5, alleging that they raised more than $700 million from late 2013 to 2015 while deceiving investors about the company's technology, business and financial performance; Balwani was also charged with aiding and abetting.
facts.quote: The SEC charges Theranos, Holmes and Balwani with violating Section 17(a) of the Securities Act of 1933 and Section 10(b) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Rule 10b-5 thereunder. The SEC also charges Balwani with aiding and abetting Theranos and Holmes in violating these provisions.

sources.title: Litigation Release No. 24069

facts.claim: Theranos and Holmes settled the SEC's charges without admitting or denying them; Holmes agreed to a $500,000 penalty, a ten-year bar on serving as an officer or director of a public company, and the return of 18.9 million shares. Balwani did not settle and the SEC said it would litigate against him.
facts.quote: Not serve as an executive or director of a public company for 10 years; Pay a $500,000 monetary penalty; and Return the 18.9 million shares of the company she obtained during the fraud.

sources.title: Litigation Release No. 24069

facts.claim: On January 3, 2022 a federal jury in San Jose convicted Holmes of one count of conspiracy to commit fraud on investors and three counts of wire fraud on individual investors involving wire transfers totaling more than $140 million; it acquitted her of the patient-related conspiracy count and three patient-fraud counts, and deadlocked on three further counts.
facts.quote: On January 3, 2022, a different federal jury convicted Holmes of one count of conspiracy to commit fraud on investors and three counts of committing fraud on individual investors, which involved wire transfers totaling more than $140 million. The jury acquitted Holmes of the patient-related fraud conspiracy count and the three counts of fraud against individual patients.

openQuestions: The site says board members provided legitimacy 'in exchange for equity'; no source returned documents directors' equity compensation. Whether and how directors were compensated should be checked in the trial record or Fortune's reporting.
The site names David Boies and Boies Schiller as suppressing whistleblowers and taking $30 million in fees and stock; none of the sources returned covers this.

The site's loss figures (Walgreens $140 million, Safeway $30 million, family offices $600 million) and the claim that Fortress Investment Group acquired the patent portfolio were not covered by the sources returned.

The site's claim that Theranos tested blood on third-party Siemens/Roche analyzers is consistent with the SEC's allegation that the company used third-party analyzers rather than its own technology, as reported by AP/WRAL; the SEC complaint itself was not retrieved.

When each director joined is unresolved: a Santa Clara University teaching note gives Shultz's tenure as 2011-2015, while a Fortune 2014 summary was read as saying he joined in 2014; Kissinger's start date was not found; Mattis told Fortune in 2014 he joined after retiring from the military.
The Holmes criminal case covers only her Theranos role; the site's 'thiel' lineage tag for this node was not examined.
